```{python}

import report_charts as charts
import report_data as data
import stats_complexity_by_hour as hours
import stats_patterns

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
charts.setup(data.GAMES_TABLE)
```

## The most in-demand games

[Hot Games, and the hottest games that weren't on the list.]

```{python}
charts.exhibit("games", dict(sort=True, search=True, views=[
    ["All", data.ranked()], ["Hot Games list", data.ranked(lambda g: g["hot"])], ["Not on the list", data.ranked(lambda g: not g["hot"])]]),
    "Most in demand", "Share of the con when every copy was out", note="Placeholder note.")
```

[By year.]

```{python}
charts.exhibit("games", dict(sort=True, views=[[str(y), data.ranked(lambda g: g["y"] == y)] for y in range(2026, 2021, -1)]),
               "Most in demand, by year published", "Share of the con when every copy was out")
```

```{python}
dots, rate = data.by_year()
charts.exhibit("dots", dict(games=dots, names=data.YEAR_NAMES, ticks=data.YEAR_TICKS, what="Published"), "Every game in the library, by year published")
```

```{python}
charts.exhibit("share", dict(rate=rate, names=data.YEAR_NAMES, ticks=data.YEAR_TICKS, what="Published", max=1), "Share of library games checked out, by year published")
```

[Older games.]

```{python}
charts.exhibit("games", dict(sort=True, views=[["1990–2015", data.ranked(lambda g: g["y"] and 1990 <= g["y"] <= 2015)],
    *[[n, data.ranked(lambda g, a=a, b=b: g["y"] and a <= g["y"] <= b)] for n, a, b in (("1990s", 1990, 1999), ("2000s", 2000, 2009), ("2010–15", 2010, 2015))]]),
    "Most in demand, older games", "Share of the con when every copy was out")
```

## Complexity by time of day

[Complexity and time of day.]

```{python}
checkouts = hours.load()                 # one row per checkout: day, hour, complexity
result = hours.test(checkouts, rng)      # is the hour-to-hour change more than chance?
by_hour = hours.summary(checkouts, rng)  # averages, and the range chance alone would give
party = hours.summary(hours.load(hours.in_category("Party Game")), rng)
```

```{python}
charts.exhibit("hourly", dict(S=by_hour, ticks=[1.8, 2, 2.2, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8]), "Average complexity by time of day")
```

[Numbers come from the code: `{python} f"{result['n']:,}"` checkouts, from `{python} f"{by_hour['m'][0]:.2f}"` at 8 AM to `{python} f"{by_hour['m'][-1]:.2f}"` at 11 PM. Hour explains `{python} f"{result['share_explained']:.0%}"` of the variation (p = `{python} f"{result['p_hours_shuffle']:.4f}"`).[^method]]

```{python}
charts.exhibit("stack", dict(H=by_hour["H"], n=by_hour["n"], mix=data.complexity_mix(checkouts), names=data.BAND_NAMES), "Mix of complexity by time of day")
```

```{python}
charts.exhibit("hourly", dict(S=party, ticks=[0, .05, .1, .15, .2], percent=True), "Share of checkouts that were party games")
```
